evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: four canopy nodes (ochre, amber, rust, graphite) emit amber dots along hyphae into a grey central web; by shot-08s the rust node sits under a blurred shade glow, but the reversed flow is hard to read.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: a vector hyphal network with blurred shade glows and dot streams; by shot-20s radial mirror symmetry doubles it to six nodes. No visible reaction-diffusion texture or material layering appears.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: cohesive cream, ochre and rust palette with clean soft glow blobs; the hyphae are stair-stepped polylines, and the top 40 percent of shot-02s is empty ground.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: a four-node radial sink network in cream and rust, unlike the flat contours, card weave, flocking birds or spiral rings of the anchors; shot-20s shows no Gray-Scott spot pattern.
evidence.polish: shot-20s: the mirrored six-node layout resolves from the sparser shot-02s, but the frame stays top-empty and the opening frame reads as an unfinished composition.

pairwise_justification: No median archive yet, so there is no head-to-head comparison to make.

critique.change: Make the reversal legible: at the 6.5 s cut, tint the reversed dots a distinct colour and animate a visible flip of the shaded node's hyphae so the stream clearly runs back toward it (shot-08s).
Fill the empty top 40 percent of shot-02s and shot-20s by scaling up the central web or seeding the promised Gray-Scott spots, so the frame is not sparse.
Replace the stair-stepped hyphae polylines with smoothed, tapered strokes and sharper dot sprites so the lines read as organic filaments at full size (shot-08s and shot-20s).
